description: This file contains benchmarking functions for different state types (value, list, map, timer) used in PySpark's streaming state server. It includes performance measurement code for state operations via a custom API client, with functions to run benchmarks and a main entry point to execute specific tests based on command-line arguments.

classes.name: ListTimerIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for listing timers via the API client.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorApiClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the stateful processor API, supporting operations like set implicit key, register timer, delete timer, etc.

methods.name: benchmark_value_state
methods.description: Benchmarks get and update operations on value state, measuring latency percentiles.

methods.name: benchmark_list_state
methods.description: Benchmarks list state operations including get, put, clear, and append, measuring latency percentiles.

methods.name: benchmark_map_state
methods.description: Benchmarks map state operations including key listing, iteration, contains, update, remove, measuring latency percentiles.

methods.name: benchmark_timer
methods.description: Benchmarks timer registration, listing, and deletion, measuring latency percentiles.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes API client and runs specified benchmark based on command-line arguments.
